dedupe_keys.name: lcz4r local climate zone analysis toolkit

description: LCZ4r is an R package maintained by Max Anjos for processing and analysing Local Climate Zones and urban heat-island patterns. It helps users obtain LCZ layers, prepare spatial summaries and create visual comparisons across neighbourhoods. Inputs are mapped local-climate-zone classes, weather or temperature observations, and an urban area; outputs are processed zones, statistics and heat-island visualisations for that place and observation period. Geographic coverage depends on available local zone data and is user-defined. The package DESCRIPTION states MIT terms, and installation and usage examples are public. The README marks the work experimental. A limitation is that LCZ categories describe urban form but do not themselves simulate building temperatures or validate a future heat scenario; observations and an urban climate model remain necessary. LCZ4r can prepare land-cover inputs and exposure indicators for city-heat simulations. The catalogue's model-palm-4u-urban-climate is a distinct urban weather model. No LCZ map or package was downloaded.
